# Tomato Player

> Tomato Player is an open-source (MIT), modular, SSR-safe web video player ecosystem. A ~5.7 KB gz core drives the native <video> element. Skins, plugins, streaming providers (HLS via hls.js, DASH via dash.js) and framework bindings (React, Vue, Svelte, web component) are separate packages, so apps ship only what they use.

## About

- What it is: a free, open-source web video player for websites and web apps. One dependency-free engine runs many complete, swappable interfaces ("skins"): nine today, switchable at runtime and themed with `--tp-*` CSS design tokens.
- Who it is for: media, OTT and learning-platform teams shipping their own player, and frontend developers adding video to React, Vue or Svelte apps.
- License: MIT. Copyright (c) 2026 Tomato Player contributors. Maintained by playlikeboy (https://github.com/playlikeboy).
- Source code: https://github.com/playlikeboy/tomato-player
- Website and docs: https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/
- Status: version 0.1.0, the first public release (2026-11-21). The npm packages (`@tomato-player/*` and `tomato-player`) are not published yet; build from the repository until they are.
- Skins: Minimal (default), Cinema, Studio, Creator, Learn, Campus, and the unofficial, platform-inspired Stream, Tube and Feed. The unofficial skins use no third-party logos, fonts or assets and imply no affiliation.
- Accessibility: every official skin targets WCAG 2.2 AA (labelled buttons and sliders, visible focus, captions, keyboard shortcuts, reduced-motion support).
- There are no published benchmarks, download counts or customer case studies.

Key facts for code generation:
- Create a player: `createPlayer(targetSelectorOrElement, { src, skin: minimal(), plugins: [hotkeys()], providers: [hls()] })` from `@tomato-player/core`.
- Skins are factories from `@tomato-player/skin-<name>`: minimal, cinema, studio, creator, learn, campus, stream, tube, feed. Call them: `skin: cinema()`.
- Theme with tokens: `cinema({ tokens: { accent: '#38bdf8' } })` or `createPlayer(el, { tokens: { accent: '#38bdf8' } })` sets `--tp-accent` inline on the player root.
- Custom skins: `createSkin({ name, css, tokens, build(player, root, options) { return [controls] } })` from `@tomato-player/ui`, composed from primitives such as `playButton`, `timeSlider`, `settingsMenu`, `group`, `spacer`. Scope every CSS selector to `.tp[data-skin='<name>']`.
- Plugins are factories from `@tomato-player/plugin-<name>`: hotkeys, gestures, chapters, thumbnails, playlist, analytics, media-session (export `mediaSession`), persist.
- Streaming engines are optional peer deps: `npm i @tomato-player/provider-hls hls.js`.
- State: `player.state.paused`, `player.store.select(s => s.currentTime, cb)`. Methods: play, pause, seek(seconds), setVolume(0..1), setSource(src), setSkin(skin), destroy().
- React: `import { TomatoPlayer } from '@tomato-player/react'` -> `<TomatoPlayer src skin={minimal()} />`. Memoize skin/plugins.
- No bundler: `<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/playlikeboy/tomato-player@cdn/tomato-player.global.js">` then `<tomato-player src="..." skin="cinema">`.
- Never call createPlayer during SSR render; use effects/onMounted/actions.

## Docs

- [Website](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/): docs with search, [skins](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/skins/), [plugins](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/plugins/), [live demos](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/demos/), [playground](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/playground/)
- [Getting started](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/docs/getting-started.md): install, first player, CDN, frameworks
- [Player API](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/docs/api/player.md): options, state, methods, events, error codes
- [UI primitives](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/docs/api/ui.md): controls for building skins
- [Architecture](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/docs/concepts/architecture.md)
- [Skins and theming](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/docs/guides/skins.md): built-in skins, options, tokens, data attributes, CSP
- [Plugins](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/docs/guides/plugins.md)
- [Streaming, HLS, DASH, DRM](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/docs/guides/streaming.md)
- [Frameworks](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/docs/guides/frameworks.md): React/Next, Vue/Nuxt, Svelte/SvelteKit, web component
- [Accessibility](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/docs/guides/accessibility.md)
- [Troubleshooting](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/docs/troubleshooting.md)
- [Migration from Plyr, Video.js, Vidstack, ReactPlayer](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/docs/migration.md)

## Extending

- [Custom skins: the complete guide](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/docs/guides/custom-skins.md): theme with tokens, override CSS safely, build a skin from UI primitives, test, publish to npm, use from React/Vue/Svelte/HTML, with a full worked example
- [Create a skin](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/docs/guides/create-a-skin.md): short monorepo workflow
- [Create a plugin](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/docs/guides/create-a-plugin.md)
- [Create a provider](https://playlikeboy.github.io/tomato-player/docs/guides/create-a-provider.md)
